Cargo Versatility
Easier than ever to pack up and go, the
2018 Crosstrek has more cargo room—up
to 55.3 cubic feet with the rear seats folded
down—and a rear gate opening that is up
to 4 inches wider for easier loading and
unloading. The standard roof rails also give
you more carrying options for bigger plans,
while 60/40-split flat-folding rear seatbacks
can help you transport longer items and a
passenger or two at the same time. There’s
also a durable cargo area tray,1 standard on
Premium and Limited trims, to help transport
wet and muddy gear.
